decisions.reason: As a simple plugin close to the firm's webshop core, it likely remains cheap to maintain, so despite weak visibility the option value is still slightly worth preserving.

After several years with no visible traction and clear overlap in the price-comparison area, uncertainty has largely resolved and the firm would reallocate resources to stronger core and new projects.
This overlapping price-comparison tracking plugin now offers limited additional learning or strategic upside relative to its maintenance and portfolio complexity, so it would be discontinued.
Because reporting functionality fits the firm's technical and analytics capabilities and may still serve a niche client need at low cost, management would keep it for now while monitoring demand.
